illustration_style: Whimsical cosy autumn storybook colouring-book line art, translated into an original bold-and-easy printable format.
line_weight: Bold, clean black outer contours with medium-weight interior details; consistently generous open areas for colouring.
line_quality: Smooth rounded digital linework with a lightly hand-drawn organic character; closed, unbroken shapes and crisp edges.
detail_level: Medium detail: each page has a clearly readable main vignette with a restrained layer of seasonal decorative details, avoiding tiny marks and dense textures.
character_language: Friendly simplified cartoon proportions, with rounded silhouettes, expressive dot-and-curve faces, uncomplicated limbs and clear readable gestures.
background_density: Moderately detailed scene backgrounds built in shallow layers, with controlled negative space and broad colourable areas.
composition: One strong focal vignette per page, supported by a simple foreground and receding background; balanced detail distribution and no text-dependent storytelling.
palette: Monochrome black line art only; designed to suit any autumnal colouring palette chosen by the customer.
shading: No tonal fills, gradients, hatching or solid black shadows; depth is conveyed through overlaps, contour lines and sparse interior accents.
texture: Clean white-paper finish with no simulated grain, speckling or distressed effects, ensuring clear home-print results.
mood: Warm, gentle, playful and quietly nostalgic, with a relaxed seasonal feel.
print_considerations: High-contrast black line art on white backgrounds, suitable for A4 and US Letter home printing. Keep all essential artwork comfortably inside safe margins, use closed colouring shapes, and avoid hairline details, large ink-heavy fills and edge-to-edge elements.
shared_prompt: Original whimsical cosy autumn storybook colouring-book line art in crisp black ink on clean white paper. Use bold rounded outer contours, medium interior lines, smooth lightly hand-drawn organic shapes, medium scene detail, generous closed areas for colouring, and shallow layered depth created only through overlap and sparse contour accents. Render characters, where present, with friendly simplified cartoon proportions and tiny expressive features. No colour, grey, shading, hatching, texture, gradients or solid black fills; maintain a warm, gentle, playful printable feel.
avoid: Any reference wording, creator marks, badges, lettering shapes or cover-layout arrangements
The reference sunroom, café or wooden Halloween-stage compositions and their character groupings
Photorealism, realistic anatomy, elaborate perspective or intricate engraving
Dense micro-details, cluttered pages, hairline strokes and tiny enclosed colouring areas
Grey shading, colour fills, gradients, hatching, distressed textures or heavy black ink coverage
Misspelled text, illegible lettering or text-dependent page designs
